title: reader config does not require backend OR ipfs to be configured
description: transit/config.rs:522 validates that either [backend] or non-empty [ipfs.api_url] is present and returns ConfigError::Validation if neither is set. reader/config.rs:467 validate() has no such check. reader/src/config.rs IpfsConfig defaults api_url to http://127.0.0.1:5001, so a reader with no [ipfs] section implicitly uses Kubo at that address. An operator who deploys reader with LMDB but omits [backend] gets a reader that silently attempts Kubo connections. Scenario: reader config that only has [listen], [limits], [auth], [tls] passes validation but has no usable block store.
